schools.waiver_process_en: For an English-medium-school waiver, the student must email admissions@nd.edu; the SAT/ACT-based waiver has no stated request step.
schools.quote_en: please contact admissions@nd.edu to inquire about a waiver.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: admissions@nd.edu에 문의해서 사례별로 확인받아야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must email admissions@nd.edu to inquire; case by case

schools.name: Washington University in St. Louis
schools.other_tests: University-wide minimums (OISS): TOEFL iBT 5.0 new scale / 90 old scale; GATEWAY English Test 495. From Fall 2027, SAT/ACT no longer accepted in lieu of English test scores. MyBest not accepted. InitialView strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 교육과정 또는 미국 고등학교에서 3년 이상 공부하고 성적이 우수하면 면제될 수 있어요. 온라인 위주 학교는 보통 해당하지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Students who have completed three or more years of study in an English-medium academic program or high school in the United States with strong academic performance may be exempted; primarily online high schools typically do not qualify.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 받으려면 admissions@wustl.edu로 직접 요청해야 하고, 개별 검토 후 결정돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Students must seek the waiver by contacting admissions@wustl.edu; requests are reviewed case by case.
schools.quote_en: Students may also seek a waiver based on the exemptions listed below.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 성적이 좋아야 하고, 이메일로 요청해야 해요 (온라인 위주 학교는 제외)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Strong academic performance; request by email; primarily online schools usually don't qualify

schools.name: Emory University
schools.toefl_recommended: Expected: 100 on 0–120 scale (not a strict cutoff); 5.5+ on new 1–6 scale
schools.ielts_recommended: Expected overall band 7.5 (not a strict cutoff)
schools.other_tests: TOEFL ITP: CEFR C1 expected; TOEFL ITP Plus (Mainland China only) CEFR C1, typically 63–68 per section. Only one exam needed.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: SAT ERW 700 이상, ACT English 30 이상, 또는 최근 4년간 (외국어 과목 제외) 모든 과목을 영어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔다면 시험 없이 인정돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Proficiency can be shown by SAT EBRW 700+, ACT English 30+, or spending the most recent four years in a school where English is the language of instruction for all academic subjects (excluding world language).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 외국어 수업 빼고 모든 과목을 영어로 들어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: All academic subjects (except world language) taught in English

schools.name: Georgetown University
schools.other_tests: Accepted: DET, IELTS, TOEFL (PBT, iBT and ITP Plus). No scores stated.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수가 아니에요. 영어로 수업하지 않는 학교에 다니는 학생에게만 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required; recommended for students who attend a school where English is not the language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험이 필수가 아니라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.
schools.quote_en: Georgetown recommends, but does not require, results from an English language proficiency test

schools.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
schools.toefl_recommended: Strong applicants (not minimums): 5+ (on/after 1/21/2026) or 100+ (before 1/21/2026); TOEFL iBT Home Edition accepted
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English C1 Advanced 185+ (C2 Proficiency also accepted). SAT/ACT do not fulfill the requirement.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 입학 시점까지 최근 4년(올해 포함) 이상 영어권 지정 국가에 살았거나, 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교를 4년 이상 다녔다면 면제될 수 있어요. 영어 성적이나 SAT/ACT로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived if, by enrollment, you will have lived at least the last four years (including the current year) in a listed English-primary country, or attended a school where English is the primary language of instruction for at least the last four years (including the current year). Not waived based on English grades or SAT/ACT.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서의 영어 관련 질문 답변으로 판단해 자격이 되면 자동으로 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Application questions determine eligibility and the waiver is applied automatically if you qualify.
schools.quote_en: will waive this requirement automatically should you qualify.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 시점 기준, 현재 학년 포함 최근 4년이에요 (자동 적용)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Last four years incl. current year, by enrollment; applied automatically

schools.name: University of Southern California
schools.toefl_recommended: Recommended minimum: 100 with no section below 20 (before 21 Jan 2026); 5 with no section below 4 (on/after 21 Jan 2026). Admitted average above 111 with 25+ per section.
schools.other_tests: C1 Advanced 185+ (each skill 169+); PTE 68; SAT EBRW 650 or ACT English 27 also count as approved exams (then cannot apply test-optional). DET only if unable to sit an approved exam; DET-only admits must take USC's International Student Exam (ISE). TOEFL ITP Plus for China not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 모든 국제학생은 제출해야 하고, 어떤 경우에도 면제나 예외가 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: All international applicants whose native language is not English must submit a USC-approved exam; no waivers or exceptions.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제가 없어요. 영어 학교 재학도 면제 사유가 아니에요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waivers are granted under any circumstances.
schools.quote_en: We do not grant waivers or exceptions to this policy under any circumstances.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: 승인 시험으로 인정돼요 (이 경우 test-optional로는 지원할 수 없어요)
schools.score_waiver_note_en: Counts as an approved exam (you then can’t apply test-optional)

schools.name: University of California, San Diego
schools.other_tests: TOEFL internet-based minimum 4.5 (effective January 2026) / 83 (before January 2026); AP English Language or Literature 3, 4, 5; IB English A HL 5–7 or SL 6–7
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니고, 고교 교육을 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 받았을 때 영어 능력 증명이 필요해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Demonstration required if your native language is not English and your secondary/high school education was in a country where English is not the language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: University of Florida
schools.other_tests: TOEFL or IELTS (official scores). No minimum scores stated on the undergraduate pages read; Duolingo is not mentioned.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 TOEFL 또는 IELTS 공식 점수를 내야 해요. 학부 페이지에 면제 규정은 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores; no exemption is stated on the undergraduate pages.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 제출 대상이고, 면제 절차는 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Required for non-native speakers; no waiver route is described.
schools.quote_en: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit official scores

schools.name: University of Texas at Austin
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 유일한 공용어이자 주 사용 언어인 지정 국가(호주·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·영국·아일랜드·싱가포르·인도 등) 출신이거나, 미국 또는 지정 국가의 고등학교에서 3년 이상 공부하고 졸업하면 면제돼요. 한국은 지정 국가가 아니라서 한국 국제학교 재학만으로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if from a qualifying country (English is the sole official and primary conversational language, e.g., Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, Singapore, UK, India), or if graduating from a high school in the U.S. or a qualifying country after at least three years of study.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 페이지에 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the exemption is applied.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 미국 고등학교를 졸업해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must graduate from the U.S. high school

schools.name: Georgia Institute of Technology
schools.toefl_recommended: USG recommended 79 (4.0 on new scale); GT may expect more in holistic review
schools.other_tests: USG minimums: SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 17, PTE Academic 53, Cambridge English Scale 169, Michigan English Test 55, EIKEN Pre-1, IGCSE/O-Level English D or better, UK GCSE English C or better. Duolingo/InitialView/Vericant are welcomed as supplements but do NOT satisfy the USG requirement.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: Georgia Tech은 조지아 주립대학 시스템(USG)이 승인한 방법 중 하나로 영어 능력을 증명하게 해요. USG 기준상 영어가 공식 수업 언어인 중등(고교)·대학 학위를 증빙하거나, 미국 인가 대학의 English 1101/1102 과목을 C 이상으로 이수하면 면제될 수 있어요(캠퍼스 심사). SAT EBRW 480·ACT English 17 이상도 인정 방법이에요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Per USG policy: a waiver can be applied for proof of a secondary or collegiate degree where English is the official language of academic instruction, or English 1101/1102 (C or better) at an accredited U.S. institution (per campus review). SAT EBRW 480+/ACT English 17+ are approved methods.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 어떻게 신청하는지는 Georgia Tech·USG 페이지 모두 안내가 없어요. 점수는 지원서나 지원자 포털에 자가 보고할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Neither the GT nor the USG page says how the waiver is requested; scores can be self-reported on the application or portal.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 영어가 공식 수업 언어인 학교의 졸업장이 있어야 하고, 캠퍼스 검토를 거쳐요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Needs a secondary diploma from an English-instruction school; subject to campus review

schools.name: New York University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic (competitive 70+), Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency (competitive 191+ on Cambridge English Scale). No minimum scores.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어(가장 먼저 배우고 가장 잘하는 언어)이거나, 올해 이전 3개 학년 연속으로 모든 수업(제2외국어 제외)을 영어로만 받았다면 시험이 필요 없어요. 반대로 최근 3개 학년 중 영어 외 언어로 된 수업, ESL·ELL·IB English B 수업, 이중언어 과정이 있었다면 필요해요. SAT·ACT·AP·IB 점수로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required if English is your first language OR all schooling for the three full consecutive academic years prior to the current year was taught entirely in English (excluding world language classes). Required if any of those years included non-English coursework, English Language Support coursework (ESL, ELL, IB English B), or a bilingual curriculum. SAT, ACT, AP, IGCSE, A-Levels, IB do not waive it.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 조건에 맞으면 '제출 불필요(Not required)'로만 안내되어 있고, 별도 면제 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요. 학교가 언제든 증빙을 요청할 수 있다고 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page lists 'Not required if' criteria; no request procedure is described. NYU reserves the right to request proof at any time.
schools.quote_en: NYU Admissions reserves the right to request proof of English language proficiency
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 현재 학년 전 3년 연속, ESL·IB English B·이중언어 과정 없이 모두 영어로 들어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Three consecutive years before the current year, entirely in English, no ESL/ELL/IB English B/bilingual curriculum

schools.name: University of California, Davis
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+ (UC systemwide)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: UC Davis 페이지는 '미국에서 3년 미만 공부했고 그 전에 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업을 받은 경우' 영어 증명이 필요하다고 해요. UC 공통 기준은 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 중등교육을 마친 경우 시험이 필요하다고 되어 있어요. AP English Lang/Lit 3점 이상, IB English A 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: UC Davis: must demonstrate proficiency if you studied in the U.S. for fewer than three years and received instruction in a language other than English before you arrived. UC systemwide: exams apply if you completed secondary school in a country where English is not the language of instruction. AP/IB English, ACT/SAT sections, or college English composition also count.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제·판정 절차는 안내가 없어요. 점수는 UC 지원서에 자가 보고해요. 영어로 수업받은 한국 국제학교 학생에게 해당하는지는 페이지 문구만으로는 분명하지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described; scores are self-reported on the UC application.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: University of California, Irvine
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+ , SAT EBRW 680+ (UCI page)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 시험 필요 여부는 국적이 아니라 고교 수업 언어로 정해져요. 고교 일부라도 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔거나, 졸업 시점까지 영어 수업 기간이 3년 미만이면 증명이 필요해요. AP·IB English, SAT EBRW 680 이상 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Need is determined by language of instruction, not citizenship. Required if any high school was at an institution where English was not the language of instruction, or if you had less than three years of instruction in English by graduation. AP/IB English, ACT ELA 24+, SAT EBRW 680+ etc. also satisfy it.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure described.
schools.quote_en: not determined by citizenship, but rather by one's language of instruction
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 고등학교 과정 중 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업한 학교가 있으면 안 돼요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: No high school attended may have non-English instruction

schools.name: Boston College
schools.toefl_recommended: Recommended minimum 100 (5.0 on new scale); admitted students average 5.5 on new scale
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 미국 또는 영어 원어민이 다수인 나라의 고교에서 ESOL 없이 3년 이상 다녔거나, SAT EBRW 650 이상 또는 ACT English 29 이상이면 면제돼요. 한국 국제학교 재학만으로는 해당하지 않아서 SAT/ACT 점수가 현실적인 면제 경로예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if: English is your native language; or 3+ years at a U.S. high school or another majority native English speaking country in a traditional curriculum without ESOL; or SAT EBRW 650+ / ACT English 29+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 조건만 안내되어 있고 신청 방법은 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Only criteria listed; the page does not say how the waiver is obtained.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESOL 없는 일반 교육과정이어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Traditional curriculum without ESOL

schools.name: Tufts University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic (generally 68+). TOEFL ITP Plus and IELTS Indicator not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어를 주 수업 언어로 하는 중등학교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 영어 시험을 제출하지 않아도 돼요(원하면 제출 가능). 단, 중등 과정에서 ESOL 수업을 들었다면 증빙을 요청받을 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants with at least three years at a secondary school where the primary language is English do not need to submit testing (optional). Students in ESOL classes may be asked for proof.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 페이지에 '제출할 필요 없음'으로만 적혀 있고, 별도 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page says such students 'do not need to submit'; no request step is mentioned.
schools.quote_en: do not need to submit English proficiency testing, though they may if they would like
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESOL 수업을 들었다면 증빙을 요청받을 수 있어요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Students in ESOL classes may be asked for proof

schools.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
schools.ielts_recommended: Typical 7.5–8 total, at least 6 in each module
schools.other_tests: ACT or SAT may be submitted instead (then used for all aspects of review); if ACT/SAT reported, TOEFL/IELTS/IELTS Indicator/DET still strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 최근 3년(10~12학년)을 영어가 공용어인 지정 국가(미국 본토·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주 등)에서 마치지 않았다면 TOEFL·IELTS·Duolingo·ACT·SAT 중 하나를 꼭 내야 해요. 한국은 지정 국가가 아니고, 이 요건은 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: If you did not complete Grades 10–12 in an approved English-speaking country, you must submit TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, ACT, or SAT. This requirement cannot be waived.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 제도가 없어요. 영어 시험이나 SAT/ACT 점수를 내야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver; submit an English test or SAT/ACT.
schools.quote_en: This requirement cannot be waived.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 10~12학년을 미국 본토에서 마쳐야 해요 (푸에르토리코 등 미국령 제외)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Grades 10-12 completed in the mainland U.S. (not Puerto Rico/territories)

schools.name: University of Wisconsin--Madison
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 중등학교 4년 내내 영어가 주 수업 언어였다면 면제받을 수 있어요. IB HL English·AP English·ACT·SAT·Cambridge·PTE 점수로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waivable if English was the primary language of instruction in all four years of secondary school. IB HL English, AP English, ACT, SAT, Cambridge, PTE cannot be used to waive.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원 후 Student Center의 Student eForms에서 'ELP Waiver Request' 양식을 직접 제출해야 해요. 성적표가 접수된 뒤 검토하며 최대 14영업일 걸릴 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the 'ELP Waiver Request' form in Student eForms (Student Center) after applying; reviewed after transcript is received (up to 14 business days).
schools.quote_en: select “ELP Waiver Request” and complete the form
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ELP Waiver Request 양식을 제출해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must submit the ELP Waiver Request form

schools.name: University of California, Santa Barbara
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면서, 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 교육받았거나 영어 수업 기간이 3년 미만이면 증명이 필요해요. AP·IB English, ACT ELA 24 이상 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if your native language is not English AND your education was in a country where the language of instruction was not English, or you have fewer than three years of instruction in English. AP/IB English, ACT ELA 24+, SAT W&L 31+ also count.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: Ohio State University
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 550+, ACT English 21+, IELTS Indicator 6.5+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 미국 정규 인가 고교에서 3년 이상 다니고 졸업했거나, 지정 영어권 국가(미국·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주·싱가포르 등) 시민권자·학사 학위 보유자면 충족돼요. 한국 국제학교 학생은 해당하지 않아 시험이나 SAT EBRW 550·ACT English 21 이상으로 증명해야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Met by approved test score (incl. SAT EBRW 550+/ACT English 21+), 3 full years and graduation from a U.S. regionally accredited high school, or citizenship/bachelor's degree from listed countries.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure described.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 졸업까지 해야 해요 (미국 정규 인증 고교)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must graduate (U.S. regionally accredited high school)

schools.name: Boston University
schools.toefl_recommended: Most competitive: 90–100+ composite with 20+ per section (old scale); 5.0+ (new scale from 2026-01-21)
schools.ielts_recommended: 7.0+ satisfies BU's requirement for all programs
schools.other_tests: IELTS Indicator, TOEFL ITP Plus, TOEFL Essentials, IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 시험이 필요해요. 페이지에 구체적인 면제 기준은 없고, 면제 여부는 입학사정위원회 재량으로 정해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if your first language is not English. No specific waiver criteria listed; waiver is at the discretion of the Board of Admissions.
schools.waiver_process_ko: English Proficiency Waiver Request Form을 작성해 지원 마감일까지 완성된 지원서와 함께 제출해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Complete the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form; must be received by the application deadline with a complete application.
schools.quote_en: To submit a waiver request, please complete the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form

schools.name: Rutgers University--New Brunswick
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 21, PTE 53, Michigan English Test 56, Cambridge B2. New Brunswick TOEFL new-scale 4.5. Pharmacy/Nursing: TOEFL 100 (old) / 5.5 (new), DET 130.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 수업하는 학교(English medium school)에 다닌 경우 개별 심사로 면제받을 수 있어요. 미국 인가 대학의 영작문 과목을 B 이상으로 이수하면 면제예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived for students who attended an English medium school, evaluated case-by-case. Exempt with B or better in college-level English Composition at an accredited U.S. college.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서를 완성한 뒤 RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu로 이메일을 보내 면제 검토를 요청해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Email RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu to request a waiver review of your completed application.
schools.quote_en: To request a review of your completed admissions application for a waiver, please contact us

schools.name: University of Maryland, College Park
schools.other_tests: IELTS Indicator accepted. Scores at or below MEI thresholds (TOEFL 94/4.5, IELTS 6.5, DET 115) may lead to required Maryland English Institute coursework.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 미국 고교 또는 미국 인가(U.S. accredited) 고교에서 ESL 수업 없이 4년을 마쳤거나, 미국 대학 학위·55학점 이상 이수, 또는 영어가 모국어이면서 지정 영어권 국가 시민권·학위가 있으면 면제를 고려해요. 미국 인가를 받은 한국 국제학교가 여기에 해당하는지는 페이지에 따로 설명이 없어 학교에 확인이 필요해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May consider waiving if, by the deadline: four years at a U.S. high school or U.S. accredited high school without ESL coursework; a U.S. degree; 55+ U.S. semester credits incl. English Comp 1 & 2; or English is your first language with citizenship/degree from listed English-speaking countries.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 어떻게 신청하는지는 안내가 없어요. 지원서 전체를 보고 입학처가 판단한다고만 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No request procedure described; the office reviews the full file to determine proficiency.
schools.quote_en: we may consider waiving the English proficiency test requirement
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESL 수업 없이, 마감일까지 채워야 해요 (면제는 재량 검토)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: No ESL coursework, by the deadline; waiver is discretionary

schools.name: University of Washington (Seattle)
schools.other_tests: Alternative: SAT EBRW 580+ or ACT English 22+ AND B average in all HS English writing/literature courses at a school where English is the language of instruction for all grades 10–12 (official SAT/ACT scores required). TOEFL iBT special home edition and IELTS Indicator accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 초·중등 교육을 모두 호주·캐나다(영어권 주)·영국·아일랜드·뉴질랜드·미국에서 받은 경우만 면제예요. 대신 10~12학년 전 과목을 영어로 가르치는 학교에서 영어 과목 평균 B 이상이고 SAT EBRW 580 또는 ACT English 22 이상이면 요건을 충족한 것으로 봐요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt only if primary and secondary education took place in Australia, Canada (English-speaking provinces), UK, Ireland, New Zealand, or the U.S. Alternative: B average in HS English courses (English-medium school for grades 10–12) plus SAT EBRW 580+ or ACT English 22+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 절차 안내는 없어요. SAT/ACT 대안은 공식 점수를 UW로 보내면 적용돼요. 12월 31일까지 기준을 못 채우면 심사 대상에서 제외돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure; SAT/ACT alternative applies when official scores are sent. Applicants not meeting the requirement by Dec 31 are not considered.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 초·중·고 전 과정을 미국 등에서 해야 해요. 아니면 10~12학년 영어 과목 B 평균 + SAT EBRW 580/ACT English 22
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Primary AND secondary in listed countries; alternative: B avg in HS English (grades 10-12) + SAT EBRW 580+/ACT English 22+

schools.name: Lehigh University
schools.toefl_recommended: Most competitive above 90; 95+ (old) / 5.5+ (new) indicates strong proficiency; 86–94 / 4.0–5.0 may need support
schools.other_tests: SAT, SAT Subject Test and ACT cannot be used to meet the requirement. TOEFL/IELTS preferred; TOEFL Home Edition and DET considered if those are unavailable.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 올해를 제외한 최근 2개 학년 동안 정규 수업을 영어로 받았다면 시험을 제출하지 않아도 돼요. SAT·ACT로는 대체할 수 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required unless the applicant's first language is English, or the last two full years (not including the current year) of completed formal instruction have been in English.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the exemption is applied.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 현재 학년을 빼고 최근 2년이에요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Last two full completed years, not counting the current year

schools.name: Northeastern University
schools.toefl_recommended: No minimum; admitted middle 50%: 102–110 (on/before 2026-01-20); 5.0–5.5 overall and subscores (on/after 2026-01-21)
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency (middle 50% 195–202), PTE Academic (79–86). IELTS Indicator, PTE Online, TOEFL Essentials/ITP/Paper not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 입학 직전까지 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 4년 연속 풀타임으로 공부하면 면제받을 수 있어요. AP English 4~5점, IB English A 5점 이상 등의 결과를 함께 내는 것을 강하게 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if you will complete 4 consecutive full-time academic years at institutions where native English was the primary instructional language immediately before enrolling; AP/IB/IGCSE/A-Level English results strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원 후 Application Status Check 포털에서 면제 요청(waiver request)을 직접 제출해야 해요. 보통 3~5영업일 안에 검토해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit a waiver request through the Application Status Check portal; typically reviewed within 3–5 business days.
schools.quote_en: You submit a waiver request through your Application Status Check portal.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 직전 연속 4년 full-time이어야 하고, 포털에서 신청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Four consecutive full-time years right before enrolling; request via portal

schools.name: Purdue University--Main Campus
schools.other_tests: ACT English 26+ or SAT EBRW 600+ (required minimums). TOEFL requires 20+ per section (old) or 4.5 overall with 4.0+ each section (new). IELTS Online/Indicator accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 가르치는 교육과정에서 3년 이상 공부하고, 영어 과목 모두 B 이상, 전체 성적이 우수하면 시험 대신 고려될 수 있어요. SAT EBRW 600·ACT English 26 이상으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: A completed English-taught curriculum may be considered: at least three years of English-taught curriculum, B or better in all English courses, strong overall performance. SAT EBRW 600+ / ACT English 26+ also accepted.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 신청 절차는 없고 지원서 심사 중에 영어 능력을 평가한다고만 적혀 있어요. 시험 없이 합격하면 입학 후 영어 배치고사를 볼 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Proficiency is evaluated during application review; no request step described. Students admitted without a formal exam may take an English placement exam.
schools.quote_en: will be evaluated for English language proficiency during the application review process
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 모든 영어 과목 B 이상, 전체 성적 우수해야 해요 (검토 후 인정)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: B or better in all English courses and strong overall performance; considered, not automatic

schools.name: University of Georgia
schools.other_tests: Most first-years meet proficiency with SAT or ACT (required by Board of Regents). Admitted international averages: SAT EBRW 650, ACT English 30.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 대부분의 학생은 조지아 주 이사회(Board of Regents)가 요구하는 SAT·ACT 점수로 영어 능력을 충족해요. IELTS·TOEFL은 추가로 제출할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Most students meet proficiency through SAT or ACT scores required by the Board of Regents; IELTS or TOEFL may also be submitted.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 절차 없이 SAT/ACT로 충족하는 구조예요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No separate waiver; SAT/ACT generally satisfies proficiency.
schools.quote_en: Most students meet proficiency through SAT or ACT scores required by the Board of Regents.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: SAT/ACT 점수로 영어 능력을 확인해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Proficiency is generally shown through required SAT/ACT scores

schools.name: University of Rochester
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 원어민이거나, 영어가 주 수업 언어인 고교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 면제를 신청할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Eligible to request a waiver if you are a native speaker of English or completed at least three years of high school where English was the primary language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 제출 후 English Proficiency Waiver Request Form을 지원 마감일까지 내야 해요. 성적표 접수 후 검토하고 승인되면 지원 상태가 자동으로 바뀌어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form after applying, by the application deadline; reviewed after application and transcript are received.
schools.quote_en: Waiver requests will be reviewed after the submission of an application and transcript.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 면제 신청서를 마감일까지 내야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must submit the waiver request form by the deadline

schools.name: Case Western Reserve University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic 61; TOEFL paper-based 577 (on/before 2026-01-20)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 졸업 시점까지 영어로 수업하는 학교에 2년 이상 다녔거나, SAT EBRW 630 이상 또는 ACT English 26 이상이면 자동으로 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Automatically waived if you attend a school where the language of instruction is English for two years by graduation, or score SAT EBRW 630+, or ACT English 26+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준을 충족하면 자동으로 면제돼요. 별도 신청은 필요 없다고 안내돼 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Automatically waived when any one standard is met.
schools.quote_en: can be automatically waived if you meet any one of these standards
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 졸업 시점까지 채우면 자동 면제예요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: By graduation; waived automatically

schools.name: Florida State University
schools.other_tests: PTE 55, Michigan Language Assessment 55, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 180
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 모든 국제학생에게 필요해요. 1학년 지원자를 위한 면제 조건은 페이지에 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required of all international applicants whose native language is not English. No first-year waiver criteria are listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 제도나 절차 안내가 없어요. 점수는 지원자 포털에 자가 보고할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver or procedure described; scores can be self-reported on the Admissions Portal.

schools.name: Texas A&M University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL Essentials 8.5, SAT EBRW 560+, ACT English 21+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 지정 영어권 국가(영국·호주·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·아일랜드·뉴질랜드 등) 시민권자이거나 미국 고교에서 4년을 모두 마치면 면제예요. 한국 국제학교 학생은 시험이나 SAT EBRW 560·ACT English 21 이상으로 증명해야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if a citizen of listed countries (e.g., UK, Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, New Zealand) or completing all four years at a U.S. high school. Otherwise TOEFL/IELTS/SAT EBRW 560+/ACT English 21+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요. 지정 국가 시민권자는 'ELP Verified'로 본다고만 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No request procedure described; citizens of listed countries are considered 'ELP Verified'.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 4년 모두 미국 고등학교에서 다녀야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: All four years at a U.S. high school

schools.name: Virginia Tech
schools.other_tests: PTE 59, Cambridge 176, SAT EBRW 550+, ACT English 24+, IGCSE/GCSE/GCE English First Language or English Language A–C (6–9), IB English A 5+. TOEFL needs no subsection below 16 (old) / 4.0 (new).
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 지정 영어권 국가(미국·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주·싱가포르 등)에서 9~12학년 4년을 영어로만 공부하고 ESL을 듣지 않았다면 제출하지 않아도 돼요. 한국 국제학교는 해당하지 않지만 SAT EBRW 550·ACT English 24·IB English A 5 이상 등으로 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required if four years (grades 9–12) were completed in a listed native English-speaking country with English as the only medium of instruction and no ESL. Otherwise submit one listed test (incl. SAT/ACT/IB/IGCSE options).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 페이지에 '제출할 필요 없음'으로만 적혀 있고 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page says such students 'do not need to submit'; no request step mentioned.
schools.quote_en: they do not need to submit verification of English language proficiency
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 9~12학년 영어로만 수업, ESL 수업 없이
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Grades 9-12, English-only instruction, no ESL

schools.name: Wake Forest University
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived for students in schools where English is the main language of instruction (3 years minimum).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the waiver is applied.
schools.quote_en: will be waived for students in schools where English is the main language of instruction

schools.name: William & Mary
schools.toefl_recommended: Generally looking for a minimum of 100 (on/before 2026-01-20) or 5 (on/after 2026-01-21); MyBest accepted
schools.duolingo_recommended: Accepted if TOEFL/IELTS not accessible; no score stated
schools.other_tests: InitialView, Duolingo or Vericant interview can be submitted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니고 최근 4년 이상 영어가 아닌 언어로 공부했다면 TOEFL·IELTS를 강하게 권장해요. 집에서 다른 언어를 쓰는 학생도 제출을 고려하라고 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Strongly recommended if English is not your native language and your schooling in the past four years or more has been in a language other than English; students speaking another language at home should strongly consider submitting.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 필수가 아닌 권장 사항이라 면제 절차가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Testing is strongly recommended, not required; no waiver process.
schools.quote_en: William & Mary strongly recommends you take the Test of English as a Foreign Language

schools.name: University of California, Merced
schools.other_tests: Mixed-record first-years: ACT English/Writing or ELA 24+, SAT Writing 560+ or Writing and Language 31+, AP English Lang/Lit 3+, IB SL English 6+ / HL 5+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: UC Merced 페이지에는 면제 조건이 없어요. UC 공통 기준은 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 중등교육을 마친 경우 시험이 필요하다고 해요. AP·IB English, ACT, SAT로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: UC Merced page lists no waiver; UC systemwide page applies exam route to those who completed secondary school in a country where English is not the language of instruction. AP/IB/ACT/SAT alternatives listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 절차 안내가 없어요. 1월까지 점수가 도착해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described; results must arrive by January for fall.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: Villanova University
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English, PTE Academic also accepted

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Last three years of high school in the U.S.; or in a country where English is an official language and primary language of instruction; or at an English-speaking school in a non-English speaking country if U.S. accredited or an English-speaking IB World school (good academic standing).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 학생이 면제를 요청해야 하고 입학처 재량으로 승인돼요. 요청 방법(양식·이메일)은 적혀 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Applicant must request; approved at Office of Admissions' discretion. Request mechanism not specified.
schools.quote_en: Proficiency waivers are reviewed and approved at the discretion of the Office of Admissions.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 신청해야 하고, 입학처 재량이에요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must request; at admissions' discretion

schools.name: Parsons School of Design at The New School
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT new scale 5.0 with 5.0 writing and 5.0 speaking; Duolingo: 115 writing, 110 speaking (no overall stated); PTE 63; Cambridge English 185
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 고교 4년 연속 영어를 주 수업 언어로 공부했다면 면제예요. 단, 고교에서 ESL 수업을 한 번이라도 들었다면 점수를 내야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Studied in English, as the primary language of instruction, for all four consecutive years of high school; students who took any ESL courses must submit scores.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 따로 신청할 필요 없이 조건을 충족하면 자동 면제돼요. 다만 심사 후 점수 제출을 요구할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No request needed; eligible applicants are automatically waived, but the office may later require a score.
schools.quote_en: No official test waiver request is needed. We automatically waive test scores
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESL 수업 없이, 자동 면제예요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: No ESL courses; automatically waived

schools.name: Rhode Island School of Design
schools.other_tests: TOEFL minimum given on new 1-6 scale (5); SAT Reading and Writing 600 or ACT English and Reading 25 may substitute
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 수업하는 학교에서 중등교육을 마치고, ESL·ELL·ENL 없이 3년 연속 풀타임으로 수학했다면 면제될 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Completed secondary education at an institution where English is the language of instruction, with three consecutive full-time years of instruction without ESL, ELL or ENL courses.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 제출 후 지원자 포털에 있는 면제 양식을 작성해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: After submitting, complete the waiver form in the applicant portal.
schools.quote_en: a waiver form can be found in the applicant portal
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESL·ELL·ENL 수업 없이 연속 3년 full-time, 포털 양식을 내야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Three consecutive full-time years without ESL/ELL/ENL; portal waiver form

schools.name: California Institute of the Arts
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT new scale 4 (on/after 2026-01-21); PTE 53
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니어도 졸업 전 3년 이상 영어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔다면 시험 대상이 아니에요. 지원서 답변으로 면제를 검토받아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants whose native language is not English who have attended a school where English is the language of instruction for at least three years prior to graduation.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 온라인 지원서의 언어 관련 질문에 답해 면제를 요청해요. 수동 처리되며 완료되면 이메일로 알려줘요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Answer the language questions in the online application to be considered; processed manually with email confirmation.
schools.quote_en: waivers are processed manually and therefore take some time
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 지원서 언어 질문에 답해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Answer the language questions in the application

schools.name: The Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT new scale 5.0 (on/after 2026-01-21)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나 최근 4년간 주 수업 언어였다면 면제 대상이 될 수 있어요.

schools.quote_en: you may email the Office of Admissions at admissions@cooper.edu and include your explanation
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 이메일로 요청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Request by email

schools.name: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT new scale 4.5 (Jan 2026+); TOEFL Essentials 9; PTE Academic 55; BA Art History requires TOEFL iBT 5 or equivalent
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어인 학생, 해외의 미국 인증 고교 재학생, 영어 학교 4년 이상 수학자, 영어 대학 12학점 이상 이수자는 제출하지 않아도 돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: International students whose first language is English, or are attending US-accredited high schools abroad, or studied in an English-language school for 4+ years, or earned 12+ semester hours at an English-language university are not required to submit scores.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 해당 학생은 제출이 필요 없다고만 적혀 있고, 별도 신청 절차는 안내되어 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page states eligible students are not required to submit; no request step described.
schools.quote_en: are not required to submit ACT, SAT, or language assessment scores

schools.name: School of Visual Arts

schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived for native English speakers who are citizens of listed countries (England, Wales, Scotland, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Singapore, India, South Africa, Commonwealth Caribbean) and attend English-instruction schools.

schools.waiver_process_en: Conditions listed; no request process described.
schools.quote_en: This requirement may be waived for native English speakers who are citizens of
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 특정 국가 시민권자만 면제돼요

schools.waiver_process_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 지원자는 모두 시험 점수를 제출해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: All non-native English speakers must submit a test score.
schools.quote_en: you must still take the TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, or Duolingo English Test

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required with a minimum SAT 470 or ACT 18 in the English section, or official transcripts showing at least two full years of academic success at a high school or college where English is the language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 조건 충족 시 점수가 필요 없다고만 적혀 있고, 별도 신청 절차는 안내되어 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page states scores not required if conditions are met; no request step described.
schools.quote_en: MICA does not require TOEFL, IELTS, PTE or Duolingo scores if you have

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Generally waived for students studying in the U.S. all 4 years of high school; 3.0/B or better in two consecutive semesters of college-level non-ESL English at a U.S. college; or a completed 4-year Bachelor's at an English-instruction school.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 문의는 admissions@massart.edu로 보내라고만 안내해요.
